topic: A person's invention is already patented by someone else
text: I ran the numbers, did the research, and there it was: someone had already patented my invention. But here’s the thing: I built it. I problem-solved through every snag and crafted something that works. It’s not the end of the world. This just means I need to rethink, refine, and maybe even improve. After all, my design has unique features that set it apart. I’ll just have to highlight those, maybe even add a few more. It’s a challenge, sure, but it also means I have the chance to make something even better. The journey’s not over; it’s just a detour. A good one.
